phases.goal: Push the blue stapler down completely.
phases.name: press_stapler_down
phases.verify: Stapler top is depressed without sliding away.

semantic_recipe.relation_to_jsonl: Phases are transferable task guidance; the companion JSONL is the exact historical winning command sequence.

strategy_notes.coordinate_policy: Relocalize all objects, supports, contacts, and poses from current observations; do not reuse s0 coordinates.
critical_gates: TCP contacts the stapler top surface.
A second press is allowed only while official success is false and contact remains bounded.

task_language: Push the blue stapler for paper fastening down completely
vla_recipe: Exact sequence: 1:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 2:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50). For every lingbot_act, use the original task_language exactly; relocalize every pose from current observations; do not replay clean coordinates.
